description: This is a Java source file defining the PolicyUnavailableException class, a specialized unchecked exception indicating that a specific policy is temporarily unavailable. It includes constructors, builder pattern implementation, and JSON parsing support for exception instantiation.

classes.name: PolicyUnavailableException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class indicating that a specified policy is temporarily unavailable. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, providing static factory methods, JSON parsing support, and builder pattern for construction.

classes.name: PolicyUnavailableException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class providing a fluent API to construct instances of PolicyUnavailableException, supporting custom headers, message, description, cause, and hyperlink.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with the given policy ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a PolicyUnavailableException from a string message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyUnavailableException by parsing the provided JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with the specified DittoHeaders, preserving other properties.
